Subject: Gravelin Inns Submission - Referral Required

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the Gravelin Inns submission. I've reviewed the materials and everything looks complete.

However, hospitality risks require referral to our senior underwriting team for approval. Before I send this up, could you help me with a few questions?

- What specific services does Gravelin Inns provide (lodging only, restaurant, bar, event space)?
- What are the occupancy rates and average guest stay duration?
- Are there any pools, spas, or recreational facilities on-site?
- What fire protection is in place at each location (sprinklers, alarms, distance to fire station)?

Once I have these details, I'll expedite the referral and get back to you with our decision quickly.

Thanks for thinking of us!

[Underwriter name]
